name: @kwikpik/ui
description: Machine-readable component registry for the Kwikpik design system. Intended for an AI coding agent (or a codegen tool) to look up exact import paths, props, and variant values before writing UI code — read this instead of guessing component APIs from memory.

install.note: This is a workspace package (packages/ui), not published to npm. Add "@kwikpik/ui": "workspace:*" to your app's package.json dependencies, then import "@kwikpik/ui/styles.css" once at your app's entry point.

components.name: Button

asChild.description: Render as a different element (e.g. a Next.js Link) via Radix Slot.

components.usage: Use intent="primary" for the single main action per screen/section. Use "destructive" only for irreversible actions (delete, disable 2FA). "outline"/"ghost" for secondary actions alongside a primary button.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status/tag pill. Follows the 50-background/900-text semantic color pattern.
components.usage: Map product status vocabulary to type: success/delivered/settled -> completed, pending/awaiting -> processing, failed/cancelled/error -> failed, informational -> blue, neutral/unset -> grey.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline banner for page/section-level feedback (not a toast).

onClose.description: Omit to render a non-dismissible alert.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Discovered mid-audit as a real, fully-built but undocumented Figma component set (18 variants). Renders a photo/logo (src), falling back to initials or a custom icon — never a flat color circle.

src.description: Photo, business logo, or service-brand logo URL.

initials.description: 1-2 letters, shown when src is absent/fails to load.

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field with label, hint, and error states.

error.description: When set, overrides hint and applies the error border/text color.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text field, same label/hint/error API as Input.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Built on Radix Checkbox. Controlled via checked/onCheckedChange.

components.name: RadioGroup / RadioGroupItem
components.description: Built on Radix RadioGroup. Wrap RadioGroupItem children in a RadioGroup with a shared value/onValueChange.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Built on Radix Switch. Use for immediate-effect toggles (not form submit).

components.name: Tooltip
components.import: import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider } from '@kwikpik/ui'
components.description: Built on Radix Tooltip. Wrap your app (or the relevant subtree) once in TooltipProvider.

components.name: Card (primitives)
components.import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from '@kwikpik/ui'
components.description: shadcn-style composable primitives. Use these directly when none of the pre-composed variants below fit.

components.name: StatCard
components.description: Figma Card_Master, Type=Stat. A single metric tile (label + value + optional delta/icon). Source pattern: B2B_PLATFORM_UX_CONTEXT.md §3 (Transactions Made / Avg Transaction Value / Next Payout).

components.name: BalanceCard
components.figmaNode: pending — built in code first, back-port to Figma next pass
components.description: Wallet/business balance card with multi-asset indicator dots and an action row. Source: B2B_PLATFORM_UX_CONTEXT.md §3 (Fund/Transfer/Swap).

components.name: KycProgressCard
components.figmaNode: pending — built in code first, back-port to Figma next pass
components.description: The 'Verify Account' progress card (0→10→20→25→50→90/100% checklist, B2B_PLATFORM_UX_CONTEXT.md §2). This component renders the summary shell (title, percent, bar, caption, CTA) — the full step-by-step checklist is a separate future 'Stepper' component, not yet built.

components.name: InfoCard
components.description: Formalizes the ad hoc 'Info Card' frames used ~30 times across the B2B module Figma pages before this pass.

components.name: EmptyCard
components.description: Empty-state pattern used across Payment Links / Customers / Orders / Packages / Returns / Invoices / Exports (B2B and Logistics audits). Always pass a real icon — never a flat color placeholder (see project convention).

notMigratedYet: Table (shell + row + cell + filter bar + pagination) — highest-priority next component, needed by every B2B/Logistics list page
Navigation shell (Sidebar + Topbar + Mode Switcher) — needed for the Unified Portal shell
Drawer (detail panel) and Modal (transactional flow) overlays
Data viz: donut chart, bar chart
Toast/snackbar and Pagination — flagged as net-new, not extracted from an existing Figma pattern
Dropdown/Menu (Figma 'Menu Dropdown Group - Master' exists, not yet ported to code)
